name: flash-keep-awake
description: SSD mode for flash storage (iFlash, CompactFlash and SSD adapters). The iPod keeps the storage on for 30 minutes after each use, not for 1 second. When the iPod wakes from sleep, the iPod starts the storage at once. Thus the storage is ready when you choose a song. Before the storage power goes off, the iPod waits 0.5 seconds, so that the flash card can complete its writes. Use this patch only with flash storage.
hdd_warning: This patch is for flash storage. On the original hard drive, it keeps the disk turning for 30 minutes after each use. This uses more battery and causes more wear.
